concept: Looking closely at something for yourself, instead of just believing what everyone says
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character looks closely at something everyone assumed they already understood, and discovers it's different than expected
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the character find out by looking closely instead of just assuming?
exercise.practice: Student picks something familiar and looks at it closely to notice one new detail

assessment.success_marker: student names one specific new detail they noticed by looking closely
